basic_info.description: Situated in a boutique building in sought-after Mission Dolores, this 2BD/2BA contemporary condo with rare 2-car parking presents a wonderful opportunity to own a beautiful home in a prime location. Bask in an open floor plan featuring a lovely kitchen with breakfast bar, stone counters, and gas range with hood, and living/dining area with gleaming hardwood floors, fireplace with Heath ceramics tile, and floor to ceiling windows that bathe the space in natural light. The bedrooms, including primary suite, are positioned in their own wing and feature closets with custom organizer systems. The remodeled spa-like baths include primary with luxe tile, dual vanity, and stall shower with built-in bench seat. In-unit laundry and ample private storage complete this gorgeous home. Building amenities include roof deck with panoramic views and a convenient elevator. Fantastic location in one of the City's most vibrant neighborhoods, known for its warm weather and anchored by 16-acre Dolores Park. Enjoy the local art scene and myriads of food, drink and retail options, such as Tartine Bakery, L'Ardoise Bistro, and Whole Foods. Easy access to MUNI transit for those heading to the Financial District or Downtown, and to Highways 101 & 280 for longer commutes. WalkScore99 = Walker's Paradise!
